## School uniform

Summer

Boys

Polo shirt & short pants

or

Girls

Polo dress

- Sportswear t-shirt & shorts
- Cardigan / Vest (for the whole year)

Cost: The price of the whole set from $450 to $500

Winter

Boys

Polo shirt & trousers

or

Girls

Polo dress

- Sportswear t-shirt & trousers
- 2 in 1 Jacket (with quilted vest) / Quilted Bomber Jacket

Cost: The price of the whole set from $700 to $800

## Miscellaneous Fee

By paying the miscellaneous fee, the student will receive our school-based curriculum learning materials including theme books, literacy books, rhyme & song books, word cards, exercise books, parent-child activity kits, worksheets, textbooks, handbook, arts and crafts materials, files, circular bag etc.
